title: Mizzen review coverage report
description: `review-coverage.json` in the output folder: the resolved review policy, any policy diagnostics, and one entry per rendered content page, keyed by the page URL including `base`. Each entry names its stable `key`, `url`, `source`, the matched policy, a state, the commits inside the window, the distinct mailmap reviewers, and, when known, the last review. Keys are sorted by code point. No unknown state is written as satisfied: `untracked`, `unavailable`, and `no-as-of` have no reviewers or commits, and `overdue` has no commits in the window. Two builds with the same model, policy, root, history, and `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` write the same bytes.

asOf.description: The explicit instant the review windows end, in UTC ISO 8601, or `null` when none was supplied. The clock is never read.

policy.description: The resolved policy: the default for pages no rule matches, and the valid rules in declaration order.

rules.description: Valid path rules in declaration order; an invalid rule is left out and explained by a diagnostic.

diagnostics.description: Every invalid policy finding, in discovery order. An invalid rule is never applied as written.

pages.description: One entry per rendered content page, keyed by the page URL including `base`, in code-point order.

windowDays.description: Whole days a review stays fresh. A review older than this is overdue.

minReviewers.description: Distinct mailmap author names required inside the window.

rule.description: One path rule: a policy for a source path and everything below it. The most specific matching path wins; the later rule wins a tie.

path.description: Root-relative source path, using `/`, with no leading or trailing slash.

code.description: A stable identifier for one policy problem.

rule.description: The 1-based position of the rule in `rules`, when the finding is about one rule.

date.description: The committer instant in UTC ISO 8601, the same canonical string on every machine.

author.description: The mailmap author name; aliases that map to one name are one reviewer.

key.description: Stable page key: SHA-256 of the page's URL, a NUL, and its source file, the same key `trust.json` uses.

source.description: The source file, relative to the site root, with forward slashes.

policy.description: The policy this page was evaluated against, and the rule path that selected it (`null` for the default).

path.description: The matched rule path, or `null` for the default policy.

state.description: `satisfied` has a fresh review and enough distinct reviewers; `insufficient` has a fresh review with too few; `overdue` has history but no review inside the window; `untracked` has no commit; `unavailable` could not be read; `no-as-of` had no explicit instant to measure from. No unknown state is satisfied.

lastReview.description: The last commit that ever named the page, even outside the window; absent when no commit is known.

reviewers.description: Distinct mailmap author names inside the window, in code-point order. Empty for every state that cannot confirm a review.

commits.description: Every commit inside the page's window, newest first.
